name: Being Stingy
overview: Scripture teaches that stinginess leads to poverty and curses, while generosity brings blessing and increase. Proverbs warns that withholding more than is right causes harm, and those who hasten to get rich with an evil eye will face poverty. In contrast, the New Testament encourages believers to give freely, promising that generosity will be rewarded abundantly. Supporting the weak is not only a duty but a reflection of Christ's teaching that it is more blessed to give than to receive.
